verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. A probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file, the typed SDKs and the human-readable API reference pages are adjacent artifacts, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
